subject_uz: 30-sonli umumta'lim maktabi uchun isitish qozonini (koʻmir va gaz) yetkazib berish va oʻrnatish, 2 toʻplam

requirements.summary_uz: Ikki toʻplam isitish qozoni (koʻmir va gaz) yetkazib beriladi, birligi 160 000 000 soʻm.
requirements.summary_en: Two sets of heating boilers (coal and gas) at 160,000,000 UZS each, 320,000,000 UZS in total.

requirements.quote: Byurtmachi tomonidan belgilangan ishlarni bajarish (maxsulot yetkazib berish) muddati | 30 kun

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma qiymatining 30 foizi avans sifatida toʻlanadi.
requirements.summary_en: A 30 percent advance of the contract value is paid.
requirements.quote: shartnoma buyicha ishlar umumiy kiymatining 30% mikdorida avans utkazadi.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchida texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy va kadrlar resurslari boʻlishi, soliq qarzi va bankrotlik boʻlmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Bidder must have technical, financial, material and staff resources, no tax debt and no bankruptcy proceedings.
requirements.quote: Shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy, kadlar resurslarining xamda boshka resurslarning mavjudligi;

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi mashina, mexanizm va asbob-uskunalarga ega boʻlishi talab etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Bidder's machinery, mechanisms and equipment are required.

requirements.summary_uz: Qozonni oʻrnatish va montaj ishlari uchun 30 ball beriladi (eng yuqori ball).
requirements.summary_en: Installation and mounting work carries 30 points, the highest-weighted criterion.
requirements.quote: ISITISH QOZONINI YETKAZIB BERISH VA ORNATISH ISHLARI, DEMONTASH ISHLARI

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolatdan keyingi xizmat: 5 yil davomida muammo chiqsa 3 ish kuni ichida bartaraf etish yozma kafolati.
requirements.summary_en: Post-warranty service: written guarantee to fix any problem within 3 working days over 5 years.
requirements.quote: ISITISH QOZONINI 5 YIL MUDDAT DAVOMIDA BIROR BIR MUOMMOSI CHIQSA 3 KUN ISH KUNIDA KELIB BARTARAF ETISH UCHUN KAFOLAT BERISHI

requirements.summary_uz: Qozon quvvati boʻyicha rasm ilova qilinishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: A picture/document of the boiler capacity must be attached.
requirements.quote: ISITISH QOZONI BO`YICHA QUVVATI RASMI ILOVA QILINISHI

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif amal qilish muddati ochilgan kundan 5 kun.
requirements.summary_en: Bid validity is 5 days from opening.
requirements.quote: Tanlov takliflari ochilgan kundan boshlab 5 kun
